title: Hurricane Hunters fly Tropical Storm Laura
description: A crew from the 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron Hurricane Hunters flew a reconnaissance mission into Tropical Storm Laura from Charleston International Airport, South Carolina Aug. 24. The squadron relocated its operations in order to avoid detrimental impacts possible from both Tropical Storms Laura and Marco. (U.S. Air Force Video by Senior Airman Kristen Pittman).
